rv.q: At the end of 80 minutes, we are so glad she came.
Indeed, This is My Favorite Song is a kind of tightrope act: D'Uva finds laughter in loss without minimizing the pain that comes with it.
The show just needs a bit more corralling to get this scrappy material into a seamless show.
It’s ridiculously entertaining absurdity; more of that, please.
But This Is My Favorite Song remains too vague and inconsistent to merit a spot on a Spotify playlist.

cn.t: D'Uva's autobiographical show mixing stand-up and music to process her father's COVID death earns mixed reviews. Critics appreciate her casual charm and inventive moments, but question whether the grief-driven premise fully justifies the performance.

vr.q: I thought this was a fantastic performance — there's like an art to the way Francesca delivers her material.
